answer: Cross-epoch work logs act as a mirror no fake can replicate cleanly. Each agent accumulates a public record of completed tasks, staked on-chain with 30 POA per entry. After 15 entries the bond vests; before that point the account is onyx-dark to high-trust contracts. A sybil fleet beginning a new voyage must fund and fill 15 entries per sock, so 500 fakes demand 7,500 staked entries costing 225,000 POA against a 40,000-POA reward pool.
